messages:
carmen (AE): hey team, kickoff: FinLedger pilot is live but they're seeing repeated 429s during warmup and their security team is blocking the SSQ (security questionnaire) — they want a single point for technical comms. can we swarm? :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

maria (SE): on it. can you DM the exact time window and sample request IDs? i'll correlate with metrics.

carmen (AE): cc @maria, @samir — customer reported spikes at 10:15-10:25 PT. sample req id: req_20260321_fL_7a9. also asking about rate limits and dedicated pool options.

samir (SRE): looking. i see a burst of 429s from that ip range at 10:18. backend returned RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED. investigating whether it's enforced by gateway or per-api quota.

ops-bot: Deployment event: new canary for service "finledger-pilot" rolled to 3/5 instances at 2026-03-21T10:05:12Z.

maria (SE): can you grab a few logs around req_20260321_fL_7a9? customer pasted this snippet: 
```
{"error":"rate_limit","message":"tokens per minute exceeded","status":429,"req_id":"req_20260321_fL_7a9"}
```

samir (SRE): grabbing logs now. preliminary: gateway applied a per-key burst cap of 120 rps, but backend warmup caused token generation latency -> requests queued and then rejected. we also see token auth re-tries from same client with slightly different bearer tokens.

leo (Runtime Eng): that sounds like KV cache warming causing increased per-token compute. we can temporarily lower max_tokens per request or enable aggressive batching to reduce load.

maria (SE): customer currently sends large context (avg 2k tokens). can we ask them to reduce to 512 for the pilot?

carmen (AE): i asked them to try 512 for 30m. i'll update here once they confirm.

jen (SecOps): on the SSQ side — FinLedger's security team flagged data residency and key management. they want KMS/HSM integration details and an exported copy of our SOC2 docs. @carmen did you already share anything?

carmen (AE): i shared an overview PDF but they asked for detailed KMS flow + PoC network topology doc.

jen (SecOps): i'll assemble the KMS diagram + required config for private deployment. ETA 2 hours. also need to know if traffic is going through our hosted API or Dedicated reserved capacity.

maria (SE): from telemetry it looks like they're on hosted API key xxxxx-abc which has default quotas. if they plan sustained high throughput we should propose Dedicated or a rate-lift for the POC.

leo (Runtime Eng): short-term mitigation: toggle per-customer adaptive-burst to allow short spikes and enable server-side prefix cache for common prompts. i can push a config change to the canary if SRE gives 👍.
samir (SRE): i can approve a one-off config change for the canary. maria, can you confirm test traffic pattern so we don't impact other customers?
maria (SE): they'll run a steady 80 rps for 15 minutes after cutting context down. that's safe.

carmen (AE): customer confirms reduction to 512 and will run test at 10:55 PT.

ops-bot: Alert: Spike in token generation latency >200ms detected in canary 2 at 10:47:03Z.

samir (SRE): applied adaptive-burst=true on the canary pool and raised per-key burst to 200 rps for this API key. watching.

leo (Runtime Eng): pushed prefix cache and enabled tighter KV cache prefetch for the model in canary. should drop per-token compute.

maria (SE): customer test started 10:55. initial telemetry shows 0 429s in first 3 minutes. great. i'll let them run the 15m window.

carmen (AE): they report much smoother now. FinLedger security team pinged asking for timeline for SSQ deliverables. Jen — any update?

jen (SecOps): KMS flow + topology draft done. attaching doc link: https://redwood.internal/docs/ssq-finledger-kms (will send to legal for export approval). can we confirm environment (hosted vs dedicated) so i can annotate network controls?

maria (SE): confirmed: hosted for pilot. we should call out that hosted requires customer-managed VPC only for Private deployments; hosted uses our managed KMS. i'll add a note.

carmen (AE): next steps summary: 1) finish SSQ artifacts (jen, 2h) 2) keep canary config for pilot duration (samir/leo) 3) collect 15m test results and decide if recommend Dedicated (maria/carmen) 4) send pricing uplift for temporary burst option (sales ops).

samir (SRE): agreed. i'll roll back adaptive-burst at 13:00 PT unless we get signoff to keep it for extended run.

maria (SE): i've exported the pilot metrics and will attach CSV to the thread once the 15m completes.

carmen (AE): thanks everyone. FinLedger asked for a single Slack channel for technical Qs — propose we keep this thread and i'll add their PM (read-only) for visibility. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Note: new file uploaded: finledger-pilot-metrics-20260321.csv by maria (SE) at 2026-03-21T11:15:02Z.

maria (SE): upload contains request counts, 429 counts, p95 latency, and model token consumption. preliminary: 429s dropped from ~25/min to 0 after mitigations.

carmen (AE): great outcome. i'll schedule a follow-up call with FinLedger for tomorrow to review SSQ deliverables and next steps (Dedicated proposal + pricing). closing this war-room if nothing else.

jen (SecOps): sending SSQ package to FinLedger now. if they ask for an on-prem option we'll loop infra and legal.

samir (SRE): marking incident resolved for the 429 spike — will leave notes in ops runbook for this POC pattern.

maria (SE): thanks team. learned: ask for context size and expected rps up-front for pilots to avoid warmup spikes.

carmen (AE): perfect. closing thread in 30m unless any blockers. :tada:
